cited.quote: Rs.251.22 Crore has been sanctioned as incentive to the farmers.

rationale: Only C3 touches support prices (paddy MSP plus state incentive, Rs.2,060 per quintal for Grade A). No extract shows a rise to Rs.2500 per quintal; the copra and blackgram GOs only notify central schemes. Crop is not named in the promise, so doubt remains.
No extract concerns allotting three periods a week to physical education; they cover sports camps, scholarships, Anganwadi education and life-skills training.

cited.quote: it is proposed to establish a Horticultural College and Research Institute at Jeenur, Krishnagiri District

rationale: Extracts show horticulture items elsewhere (C4/C5 college and institute at Jeenur, C1 special centres), none a research centre at Mannavanur, Kodaikanal. Related activity at a different place does not fulfil the promise.
No extract mentions the Athikadavu-Avinashi scheme. C1, C2, C4 and C5 are about other schemes and C3 is a municipal policy note unrelated to it.
No extract mentions moving Education between the Concurrent List and State List or any related step; the extracts cover school and higher education administration only.
No extract concerns re-including the 21 enterprises in the central MSME list. C2 and C3 describe Udyam registration and classification only; C1, C4 and C5 are other MSME GOs.

cited.quote: all the 4,57,645 petitions received under the programme have been acted upon.
On 08.05.2021, Hon’ble Chief Minister handed over the keys of the boxes containing the petitions

rationale: C3 shows the petitions handed to a Special Officer on 08.05.2021, with disposal reviewed daily. C2 states all 4,57,645 petitions were acted upon and the 100-day commitment implemented. C1 also reports resolution under a Special Officer within 100 days. Some doubt over wording of 'resolved'.

cited.quote: this Government will focus its attention to make agricultural graduates as entrepreneurs.

rationale: The field is not named; the closest item is C3, a budget speech statement of intent to make agricultural graduates entrepreneurs. No GO operationalises it. C1 only adds a financial partner to an existing youth scheme.

cited.quote: There are 528 Town Panchayats in Tamil Nadu comprising of 8,288 wards

rationale: C1 and C3 discuss Town Panchayats and their amenities, and C2 and C5 sanction road works; C4 notifies election reservations. None shows any step to divide larger town panchayats.

cited.quote: accord Administrative Sanction for a sum of Rs.828.50 Lakh

rationale: C4 is a GO of 10.12.2021 sanctioning preparation of detailed project reports for bypasses to 13 towns including Trichy and Tiruppur. C2 says the department proposes land acquisition then road works in two phases. Only DPR preparation is sanctioned, so not yet operational.

cited.quote: is the competent authority to issue Scheduled Tribe community certificates

rationale: C2 describes the existing community certificate process for Scheduled Tribes, with no new procedural framework for Hindu Kanikkar and Irular communities. C1 covers Adi Dravidar certificate verification. No new step is shown.

cited.quote: This scheme will be continued during the year 2021-22
The Government have provided Rs.1000/- per month as Old 31 Age Pension

rationale: C1 describes the Savings and Security Scheme as continuing on the existing terms (matching contributions, 6.50% interest). C2 shows related pensions still at Rs.1000. No extract shows an increase to Rs.2000.
No extract concerns the release of the seven convicts or Perarivalan. The extracts cover prison policy, Covid child relief, housing and rural livelihood funds.

cited.quote: which the sugar mills are bound to pay within 14 days of purchase of cane.
non-payment of cane price to the farmers in time

rationale: C4 only restates the central rule that mills pay within 14 days; C3 notes delayed cane payments. C1 and C2 sanction a special incentive to farmers, a different measure. No state deadline for pending arrears or penal action is shown.

cited.quote: recruit 1000 fishermen youth as Home guards in a phased manner over a period of 3 to 4 years

rationale: The promise names no category. C2 is a GO of 20.04.2022 on recruiting additional home guards for Coastal Security, with initial recruitment of 300. This covers only one group. C5 creates posts by surrendering constable posts, so it adds no net personnel. Wide uncertainty about intended scope.

cited.quote: Financial assistance has been provided to establish Tamil Chair in Universities of other states and Foreign Countries

rationale: C1 describes earlier assistance for Tamil chairs and a Rs.1.25 crore grant to keep the Cologne Tamil department running; this sustains an existing department rather than instituting a new chair, and is not a dated GO. No new chair is shown.

cited.quote: Traditional Industries such as_ salt production, silver anklet & silver lamp making, brass articles, vessels making industries

rationale: C4, a GO of 22.10.2021, brings these traditional industries under the thrust sector for Special Capital Subsidy, a step to boost production. No extract shows a declaration as cottage industries. C5 gives relief to salt workers, a different measure.

cited.quote: subsidy will be extended for the purchase of modern jaggery making machineries

rationale: C1 is a budget speech stating training and machinery subsidy will be given; no GO or launch is shown. C3 and C5 permit sale of palm jaggery in fair price shops, which is about distribution, not production technology.
No extract concerns a Madurai-Melur-Karaikudi broad gauge rail line. C1, C2, C4 and C5 are about metro or MRTS feasibility studies and C3 is a village scheme list.
No extract concerns urging the Union government on new courts for the Southern Region. C1 and C2 describe the state judiciary, C3 printing, C4 and C5 regional planning rules.
